# Requirements Quality Checklist: Approvals that carry a decision, guided pipeline repair, and a uniform question standard

**Purpose**: Validate that this feature's requirements are complete, clear, consistent and objectively verifiable before planning commits to an approach
**Created**: 2026-09-05
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Clarity — terms that carry the decision

- [ ] CHK001 Is "readily undone" defined normatively rather than only in Assumptions, given FR-002 and FR-003 both turn on it? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK002 Is "differs in any way from what the maintainer approved in the plan" specified precisely enough to decide a borderline case — reworded but equivalent, reordered, or a differing artifact list? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK003 Is "the plan" the maintainer approved identified as a specific named artifact, so that FR-001's comparison has two defined sides? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK004 Is "normative" defined, given FR-028, FR-029 and SC-010 all rest on distinguishing normative text from other text? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-028]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the boundary between a "deliberate, reviewed revision pass" and "incidental reformatting during unrelated work" stated in decidable terms, given that distinction is the entire content of FR-025? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-025]
- [ ] CHK006 Is "verified fix" defined, or does FR-009 rely on the reader inferring it from the bug-remediation workflow's own vocabulary? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK007 Is "a cause outside the repository's own content" bounded — does a dependency pinned in the repository but broken upstream fall inside or outside? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "no default is defensible" given any criterion, or is FR-023's escape hatch available whenever a recommendation is inconvenient to produce? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-023]
- [ ] CHK009 Are "both forges the toolkit already supports" named in the specification, rather than requiring the reader to consult the codebase to know FR-010's scope? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "before it begins" in FR-011c anchored to a specific point, distinguishable from FR-011's "before proposing a cause"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011c]

## Requirement Measurability — can a reviewer check it?

- [ ] CHK011 Does FR-027 state how much shortening is required, or would removing one character satisfy it? [Measurability, Spec §FR-027]
- [ ] CHK012 Does SC-010's "shorter than its previous version" express the intended outcome, given it is satisfied by a trivial reduction? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-010]
- [ ] CHK013 Is there a stated procedure by which FR-029's "establishable by comparison" is carried out, or does it rest on a judgement no procedure produces? [Measurability, Spec §FR-029]
- [ ] CHK014 Does SC-001's "strictly fewer than the number of phases" capture the intent, given it is satisfied by removing exactly one approval out of eight? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK015 Can SC-002 be evaluated after the fact — is a run required to record, per phase, which condition applied? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK016 Is FR-034's "re-examined and its outcome recorded" verifiable, or could any statement whatsoever satisfy it? [Measurability, Spec §FR-034]
- [ ] CHK017 Is SC-009's "stated in exactly one place" checkable given the standard's wording may legitimately be quoted or referenced elsewhere? [Measurability, Spec §SC-009]
- [ ] CHK018 Are the "length, structure and formatting limits the repository already places on these documents" enumerated or referenced by location, so FR-031 can be checked? [Completeness, Spec §FR-031]
- [ ] CHK019 Can SC-007's "makes no source-file change of its own" be established by observation, or only by reading the implementation? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK020 Do User Story 1's acceptance scenario 1 and FR-003 agree? **Resolved 2026-09-05**: they did not. The scenario conditioned auto-proceeding on the phase writing "only specification artifacts", while FR-003 conditions it on FR-001 and FR-002 not applying. FR-003 governs; the scenario was amended to test reversibility instead. [Conflict, Spec §US1, §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK021 Does FR-008's skip reporting interact consistently with FR-003 — is announcing a skip a form of the FR-004 announcement, a separate obligation, or an approval point in its own right? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK022 Is FR-020's "every point at which any of the toolkit's workflows requires a decision" consistent with FR-002's list of steps that always require approval, or do the two overlap without saying so? [Consistency, Spec §FR-020, §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK023 Do FR-016 (offer a return to diagnosis, uncapped) and FR-013 (offer alternatives before changing anything) state whether a second cycle re-runs the FR-012 and FR-013 approvals or reuses the first cycle's answers? [Gap, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK024 Is FR-014's "MUST NOT edit source files itself" consistent with FR-011b's fallback, in which the maintainer supplies output — does supplied output enter the record the same way retrieved output does? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, §FR-011b]
- [ ] CHK025 Are FR-024 ("recorded once, in a single place") and FR-020–FR-023 consistent about whether individual workflows may restate any part of the standard for local emphasis? [Consistency, Spec §FR-024]
- [ ] CHK026 Do FR-032 and FR-033 together account for every requirement of feature 006 that this feature touches, leaving none silently unaddressed? [Completeness, Spec §FR-032, §FR-033]

## Requirement Completeness — gaps

- [ ] CHK027 Does the specification say when and how a maintainer exercises FR-007's override — before the run starts, at any approval, or both? [Gap, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK028 Does FR-007 state whether the override persists for the whole run or applies to a single phase? [Gap, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK029 Is a minimum number of alternatives specified for FR-013, or would a single "approach" satisfy an offer of "alternatives"? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK030 Does FR-017 cover the case where the maintainer wants several failing jobs addressed together rather than choosing one? [Coverage, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK031 Are requirements defined for what the capability does when the failing evidence is retrieved but empty, truncated, or expired by the forge's retention? [Gap, Edge Case]
- [ ] CHK032 Are requirements defined for a pipeline that fails intermittently, where one run's evidence does not establish a cause? [Gap, Edge Case]
- [ ] CHK033 Does the specification state who decides FR-019's "would add or alter a requirement", and at what point in the flow that decision is made? [Gap, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK034 Are requirements defined for the FR-030 case's visibility — where a document is left unshortened, is the reason recorded durably or only reported in passing? [Gap, Spec §FR-030]
- [ ] CHK035 Does the specification address the Edge Cases entry about a phase auto-proceeding and then failing, with a requirement rather than only a narrative note? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK036 Does the specification address the Edge Cases entry about shortening removing non-normative but load-bearing context, with a requirement rather than only a narrative note? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-028]
- [ ] CHK037 Are requirements defined for what happens when FR-011a's retrieval succeeds but the maintainer disputes that the retrieved run is the right one? [Coverage, Gap]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK038 Is the assumption that the bug-remediation workflow is "fit to receive pipeline defects unchanged" validated anywhere, given FR-014 makes the whole of User Story 2 depend on it? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK039 Is the assumption that artifact compaction "is already served by tooling the repository has installed" verifiable from the specification, given FR-027a excludes artifacts on that basis? [Assumption, Spec §FR-027a]
- [ ] CHK040 Is the consequence of the assumption that this repository runs no pipeline of its own stated as a requirement — that User Story 2 cannot be verified end to end here — rather than only as an assumption? [Assumption, Traceability]
- [ ] CHK041 Does the specification record what happens to this feature's own requirements if the maintainer's forge access is revoked between preflight and retrieval? [Assumption, Edge Case]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK042 Are recovery requirements defined for a run interrupted between an approval and the step it approved? [Coverage, Recovery, Gap]
- [ ] CHK043 Are requirements defined for the exception flow in which the bug-remediation workflow invoked by FR-014 itself stops or fails? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Gap]
- [ ] CHK044 Are requirements defined for a shortening pass that is interrupted partway, leaving some documents shortened and others not? [Coverage, Recovery, Gap]
- [x] CHK045 Is each of the four user stories independently deliverable as claimed, given FR-026 sequences FR-025 ahead of User Story 4 and nothing else states a cross-story order? **Resolved 2026-09-05** by `/speckit-analyze` finding F5: User Story 4 is independently testable but not independently schedulable, and `spec.md` §US4 now carries that caveat explicitly. [Consistency, Spec §US1–US4]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- CHK020 was a genuine conflict between User Story 1's first acceptance scenario and FR-003. It was raised and resolved before planning, on 2026-09-05: FR-003's reversibility test governs, and the scenario was amended to match. It is the one item this checklist's author marked, and it is marked because the conflict it names no longer exists.
- CHK004, CHK005, CHK011, CHK012 and CHK013 all circle the same weakness: the compaction requirements rest on an undefined notion of "normative" and set no threshold for "shortened". These are the requirements most likely to be unsatisfiable as written.
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
